$comment: Command rules for guard-bash.mjs. decision is deny or ask; pattern is a case-insensitive JavaScript regular expression matched against the whitespace-collapsed Bash command. Add a case to guard-bash.test.mjs for every rule you add or change.

rules.reason: Force pushes rewrite shared history. Run it yourself if it is truly intended.
main and develop change only through pull requests (docs/engineering/delivery-workflow.md).
Discards working changes that may not belong to this task. Inspect git status and remove specific paths instead.
Stage the paths of this change explicitly so unrelated working changes stay out of the commit.
Husky runs lint-staged, type checks and commitlint. Fix the failing check instead of skipping it.
Database resets and data-loss flags are never routine verification. Run them yourself after inspecting the target.
Removing Docker volumes destroys local database data. Stop containers without -v; remove volumes yourself if intended.
Commits and pushes need the user's explicit request for this change.
Template mutation scripts change the architecture. Show the dry run to the user and apply only after their confirmation.
--force replaces regular .env files in apps and packages. Back up or merge their values first.
